calls.statement:
SELECT p.category, count(DISTINCT p.sku) skus, count(*) versions, min(valid_from) mn, max(valid_from) mx,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.subcategory ILIKE '%light%' THEN p.sku END) light_skus
FROM dim_product p GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl,
  min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at) l0, max(etl_loaded_at) l1,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.valid_from > f.sale_date OR p.valid_to < f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) badver,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) s999
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-30'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS category_as_was,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, (w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_web
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net, false
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, 'Garden' AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN n.category_as_was = 'Garden' THEN n.net_sales END), 2) AS net_sales_as_was,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.category = 'Garden' THEN n.net_sales END), 2) AS net_sales_as_is_check,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS all_cat
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),2) rpt_total, count(DISTINCT r.store_id) stores, max(r.store_id) maxstore,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=999 THEN r.net_sales ELSE 0 END),2) s999
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.category AS category_as_was, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS garden_net_sales_as_was
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.category_as_was = 'Garden' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
